+=============================================================================+
|                          ASYNC REQUEST PATH                                 |
|                                                                             |
| reactor completion -> runnable queue -> executor worker -> poll             |
|                                      |                                      |
|                                      +-> Pending: park until wake           |
|                                      +-> Ready: emit response               |
|                                      +-> blocking/long poll: delay peers    |
|                                                                             |
| latency = queueing + scheduling + polls + CPU work + I/O + downstream waits |
+=============================================================================+
